engine.title: Digital avatar engine:
engine.offline: Duix at {url} is not reachable. Start your Windows PC and Docker Desktop (container “duix-avatar-gen-video” starts automatically), then retry.
engine.share_missing: The Duix folder is not available here ({path}). Share {windows_dir} on Windows and mount it on this device (see README).
admin.engine_local_intro: Self-hosted Duix.Avatar Docker container (guiji2025/duix.avatar) on your Windows PC. This server writes the voice and model video into the folder mounted into the container and reads the result back.
admin.engine_cloud_intro: Hosted DUIX API (token). The free plan has 36 credits (≈3 min) valid for 30 days.
admin.howto.1: On Windows: start Docker Desktop and check that the container “duix-avatar-gen-video” is Up (docker ps).
admin.howto.2: Allow inbound TCP 8383 in Windows Firewall so this device can reach the API.
admin.howto.3: Share the folder {windows_dir} (Properties → Sharing) with read/write access.
admin.howto.4: On this device run deploy/mount-duix-share.sh (or set “Path to the folder on this server” when running on Windows).
admin.password_on: A password is required to use this site.
admin.password_off: No password: anyone on your network can use this site.
admin.password_help: Enter a new password and save. Save with an empty field to remove the password.
lib.avatar_models.help: Presenter clips the avatar is generated from.
lib.avatar_clips.help: Generated talking clips; re-composite them without running Duix again.
set.DUIX_API_KEY.help: Stored only in the .env file on this server.
set.duix_local_url.help: Duix container on the Windows PC, e.g. http://192.168.8.106:8383
set.duix_windows_dir.help: Host folder mapped to /code/data/temp in the container.
set.duix_share_path: Path to that folder on this server
set.duix_share_path.help: SMB mount of the Windows folder. Empty = default shown.
set.duix_timeout_seconds.help: Give up on a lip-sync task after this long.
set.duix_default_model.help: Pre-selected in the avatar form (upload models in the form or under Libraries).
set.duix_cleanup_share: Delete voice/result files from the shared folder afterwards
set.duix_wol_mac.help: Shows a “Wake PC” button when the engine is offline.
set.duix_delete_remote: Delete result from the cloud after download
set.delete_inputs_on_success: Delete uploads when a job succeeds
set.video_encoder.help: h264_rkmpp needs an ffmpeg built with Rockchip MPP; otherwise libx264 is used.

admin.ai_intro: Used for subtitle drafts (fix, translate, revise), the AI voice for typed scripts, speech recognition without local Whisper, and OCR clean-up. Default: OpenAI; any OpenAI-compatible server works (choose “Chat Completions”).
set.LLM_API_KEY.help: Stored only in the .env file on this server. Leave empty to keep the current key.
set.llm_provider.openai_compatible: Chat Completions (OpenAI-compatible: DeepSeek, Qwen, Ollama, vLLM…)
set.llm_model.help: Pick from the loaded list or type any model id.
set.llm_reasoning_effort.help: Ignored automatically by models without reasoning.
set.asr_engine.auto: Auto (local Whisper if installed, else API)
set.subtitle_font.help: Must be installed on this server (install.sh adds Noto Sans CJK).
